foreground_pause.reference: Expected foreground client demand from an independent source and a pause in foreground traffic
foreground_pause.normal_control: Confirmed idle time with no expected demand and the same background health traffic

large_upload.reference: Observed off-profile inbound body size with operation context
large_upload.normal_control: A comparable planned upload on the same route and service

large_response.reference: Observed off-profile response body size with operation context
large_response.normal_control: A comparable scheduled export or download

connection_surge.reference: Off-profile rate of new connections with known demand context
connection_surge.normal_control: A legitimate temporary demand peak with comparable traffic volume

persistent_exchange.reference: Off-profile persistent exchange with independently confirmed connection lifetime and operation
persistent_exchange.normal_control: Long-lived planned streaming or connection reuse

unknown.reference: Observable abnormal activity outside the known taxonomy, including a confirmed HTTP degradation
unknown.normal_control: Measured ordinary application performance under the same load

normal.reference: Verified expected behavior or planned changes

mixed.reference: At least two plausible labels with no unique primary type

unobservable.reference: Missing evidence for assigning normal or abnormal
